description: The agent team. EDITOR workflow (/harness:run, /harness:auto): your Claude Code session is the orchestrator and each lead below is a NAMED agent (generated into .claude/agents/ by `node .harness/team.mjs sync-agents`) that works visibly in your session; the controller (.harness/visible.mjs) validates the delegation, reverts any change outside an agent's files and runs the real check. HEADLESS workflow (dispatch --hierarchy): level 1 the orchestrator plans and delegates (read-only), level 2 each lead plans its workers, level 3 workers do the work, with a hard cost cap. Rules enforced either way: lead scopes can only narrow their role's writable paths and never overlap, budgets only shrink downwards, a lead may only be given files inside its scope, and every plan is validated before any agent starts. After editing this file run `node .harness/team.mjs validate` and `sync-agents`.
